verdict.rationale: Airweave publishes an OpenAPI spec and an SDK. The SDK covers core operations such as creating source connections, managing collections, triggering syncs and searching through a single endpoint. The docs read as API-first, but nothing explicitly claims or verifies that the API matches everything the dashboard can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of dashboard-only functions (org/user settings, billing, auth config), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
